Frames

Nothing on this page is reachable by the top-frame selector. Every control below sits behind a frame boundary.

0 — one ordinary control, so the ratio has a numerator outside the frames

1 — a NAMED frame

Addressed as iframe[name="payment"] even though iframe#payment-frame would also work — a name is chosen by the author and survives re-layout; an id is often generated.

2 — a frame with an id but no name

Addressed as iframe#terms.

3 — an anonymous frame

Addressed positionally, iframe >> nth=N — the honest last resort. A plan carrying it says out loud that it depends on document order.

4 — a frame inside a frame (the declared boundary)

The OUTER frame is perceived; the button inside it is reachable. The frame nested inside THAT one is not: depth is capped at 1 on purpose, and its control is counted in unseen.iframe with the frame itself in opaque.frames_nested — a stated boundary rather than a silent one.
